title: Mediating Conflict and Reframing Positions
summary: Clarifying interests, reframing conflict, and developing shared options.
whyItMatters: Mediation moves from fixed positions toward interests, acknowledged concerns, and jointly evaluated options.

mentalModel.title: Position is not interest
mentalModel.content: Ask what need, risk, or value stands behind a demand.

mentalModel.title: Reframing changes language, not substance
mentalModel.content: Translate accusation into an observable concern and negotiable need.

ruleBlocks.title: Clarify positions and interests
ruleBlocks.content: Ask open questions and summarize without judgment.

ruleBlocks.title: Acknowledge without automatically agreeing
ruleBlocks.content: Show understanding while preserving room for evaluation.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Was ist Ihnen dabei besonders wichtig?
Es geht Ihnen also vor allem um ...
Ich verstehe die Sorge, auch wenn ...

examples.de: Wenn ich Sie richtig verstehe, geht es vor allem um einen verlässlichen Zugang.
examples.en: If I understand correctly, the main issue is reliable access.

examples.de: Ich verstehe die Sorge, auch wenn die vorgeschlagene Lösung nicht alle überzeugt.
examples.en: I understand the concern even if the solution does not convince everyone.

examples.de: Beiden Seiten ist wichtig, dass die Entscheidung transparent bleibt.
examples.en: It matters to both sides that the decision remains transparent.

commonMistakes.wrong: Push compromise before interests are understood.
commonMistakes.reason: Early compromise may solve the wrong problem.

commonMistakes.wrong: Reframe beyond what the speaker recognizes.

comparisons.summary: The theme provides conflicts involving access and identity.
